title: Optimizing fitness: plastic flowering time in variable environments.
authors: Dong, Wei; Zhang, Yalin; Xing, Yue; Chang, Kexin; Qiu, Nianwei; Song, Yuguang
one_liner_zh: 该文综述环境胁迫下植物开花时间调控，涉及转录因子但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Flowering time is a critical determinant of crop yield and adaptability, regulated by the integration of environmental cues, phytohormones, and genetic networks. Abiotic stresses such as drought, waterlogging, salinity, and high temperature, together with biotic stresses including pathogens, viruses, and herbivores, profoundly reshape flowering phenology through microRNAs, transcription factors, epigenetic modifications, and hormonal crosstalk. Phytohormones, especially ABA and GA, act as regulatory hubs coordinating stress adaptation and floral transition, though their effects vary across species and conditions. This review synthesizes recent advances in stress-mediated flowering regulation and emphasizes the challenges of balancing stress tolerance with yield stability. We propose that integrating multi-omics data, regulatory network modeling, and artificial intelligence will accelerate the breeding of stress-resilient cultivars with stable productivity.
abstract_zh: 开花时间是决定作物产量和适应性的关键因素，受环境信号、植物激素和遗传网络的整合调控。干旱、水涝、盐碱和高温等非生物胁迫，以及病原体、病毒和植食性动物等生物胁迫，通过微小RNA、转录因子、表观遗传修饰和激素串扰深刻重塑开花物候。植物激素，尤其是ABA和GA，作为协调胁迫适应和花转变的调控枢纽，尽管其效应因物种和条件而异。本综述综合了胁迫介导开花调控的最新进展，并强调了平衡胁迫耐受性与产量稳定性的挑战。我们提出，整合多组学数据、调控网络建模和人工智能将加速培育具有稳定生产力的胁迫抗性品种。
